name: dnd-game-master
description: Anna-native multi-agent D&D game master with setup, safety guardrails, intent routing, combat/rules, NPC dialogue, adventure research, evaluation, approval and compact campaign state. Driven by the D&D Dungeon Master app window.
author: Yash

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Internal: called by the D&D Dungeon Master app window with its saved campaign state; do not call from chat. Set up a D&D party from Open5e class data and the bundled Tomb of Annihilation excerpts, and write a grounded opening scene. Returns {state, turn_record, trace}: compact campaign state plus the turn-0 record. Run as an async job; emits a progress event per stage.

parameters.name: party
parameters.description: Party members with name, class, and ancestry.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Optional campaign identifier chosen by the app for durable user-scoped storage.

tools.name: draft_turn
tools.description: Internal: called by the D&D Dungeon Master app window with its saved campaign state; do not call from chat. Run the guardrail, intent classifier, adventure lookup, ACTION/NPC_DIALOGUE/CAMPAIGN specialist, and schema and semantic evaluator within Anna's per-invoke sampling budget, and return a player-reviewable draft. Run as an async job; emits a progress event per stage.

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: Compact campaign state (the `state` returned by create_campaign or resolve_turn).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The player's declared action or dialogue.

parameters.name: dice
parameters.description: Optional d20 and d100 rolls selected by the player.

tools.name: resolve_turn
tools.description: Internal: called by the D&D Dungeon Master app window with its saved campaign state; do not call from chat. Commit a player-approved draft or discard it. Returns {state, turn_record}: the updated compact state and the new turn's events and snapshot (turn_record is null when discarded).

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: Compact campaign state the draft was written against.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: True to commit the draft; false to discard it.

tools.name: get_class_profiles
tools.description: Return the original Open5e D&D class profiles and archetypes used by the production party builder.
